Package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service

Class ImageFileProvider

java.lang.Object
android.content.ContentProvider
androidx.core.content.FileProvider
edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.ImageFileProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
ComponentCallbacks, ComponentCallbacks2
public class ImageFileProvider extends FileProvider
A specialized implementation of FileProvider for managing access to image files within the app. This class extends the functionality of FileProvider by providing file path mappings defined in the `provider_paths` resource. This class is primarily used to securely grant access to image files stored in the app's private storage to other components or applications, for example, when sharing images via intents. Note: This class uses the R.xml.provider_paths file to define URI mappings for secure file sharing.
